title: Multimodal interaction
intro: Compare contexts, try feedback channels and save your own observations.
approx: Approximate educational filters: they neither reproduce individual perception nor certify accessibility.
colorHelp: Compare color-only states with text + symbols. WCAG 1.4.1: do not convey information through color alone.
demo: Educational simulation: no physical devices are controlled.
cancelled: Action cancelled; you can try again
blocked: Visual action blocked while moving. Use the voice command or stop the simulation.
carHelp: Visual editing is blocked while moving. This demonstration does not validate road safety.
privacy: Recognition may send audio to the browser service. Activate it only if you agree; the written alternative is always available.
unsupported: This channel is unavailable. Use visual feedback or the keyboard.
unknown: Command not recognised. Use confirm, cancel or navigate.
micError: Audio recognition failed; check permissions or use text.
vibrationRequested: Vibration requested; check physically whether you felt it.
soundRequested: Sound generated; check whether you heard it.
notesHelp: Describe what you verified. The lab does not invent usability results.
conceptIntro: Try a decision, compare practices and document your evaluation.
remember: Selecting a practice is not a measurement. Record observed results.
